_comment: Least-privilege policy for the TerraRepair-Bench Fargate TASK role (taskRoleArn). Grants Bedrock invocation for the cohort and read/write to the results bucket/prefix only. Replace <RESULTS_BUCKET>. The invoke actions cover InvokeModel (Claude/raw paths) and Converse (Nova/Llama/DeepSeek-R1/Grok). Resource is * for models because CRIS inference profiles span region-qualified ARNs; tighten to specific model ARNs if your account requires it.
